finding: SimplifiedSpacecraftBuilder creates SpacecraftStructure instances exclusively from panels.csv (6 SIDE + 2 END_CAP); installation and steering records are coordinate metadata, not outer metal CAD.
library_geometry_vs_assembly: Standalone S/GPS/ISL/KAA antenna geometry libraries exist; they are not a released spacecraft external-assembly CAD. Active installed antenna is retained. Passive antenna bodies/struts/gimbals/SAR array are not defined as structure instances by this SSOT.
surrogate_status: KARMA reflector is newly owner-authorized analysis surrogate, not an added released bus-structure instance.
unmodelled: Solar arrays, booms, payload bodies, radomes, cable routing, passive antenna assemblies and gimbal hardware: no physical assembly geometry in this SSOT; not claimed absent on the actual satellite.
